## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text by [善熹](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%96%84%E7%86%B9) Shànxī is a focused polemical refutation of doctrinal errors in rival Buddhist commentaries. Together with *[Píng jīn gāng pī](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0137)* (X1018) and *[Biàn fēi jí](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0138)* (X1019), it constitutes the trio of Shànxī's polemical works engaging Tiāntái and other rival traditions on behalf of the Huáyán-school doctrine.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (1170 – 1200) reflects [善熹](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%96%84%E7%86%B9) Shànxī's mature scholarly activity. The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X1020) collection.
